lens_notes.producer_propagation: Server validate_player_input normalizes finite look to Radians then projects at the actual Ahoy CharacterLook boundary; native camera and KCC consume and replicate it. Tactical speed/config may be updated before Ahoy solver. Only exact bounded producer/consumer paths inspected; other producers and native SDK behavior remain open.
lens_notes.type_ownership: Vendored Bevy/Avian controller owns native ECS components, collider and quaternion ports; Fabelgeist owns tactical movement configuration and validated player inputs. No blanket conversion of third-party native structures is justified by their raw fields.
lens_notes.type_granularity: Controller config, retained state, derived colliders and transient per-step output have different roles; grounded/mantle options and their timers are not interchangeable. A separate finite frame or support-shape contract requires actual caller policy.
lens_notes.admission_contracts: Public and optional serde/Reflect native fields permit direct construction in this library; normal server input explicitly rejects nonfinite look, wraps yaw and clamps pitch. That admission cannot prove all reflected, deserialized, direct or camera producers valid. Supported collider and configuration policies remain open.
lens_notes.invariant_operations: Defaults feed motion and native shape operations. KCC updates orientation and clocks, and derives colliders. HalfSpace radius intentionally Infinity; actual supported actor shape must be known. Historical contract 583 alone documents a scoped saturating Stopwatch native read; it is not my native SDK read.
lens_notes.enum_shapes: Option<grounded> and Option<mantle> represent distinct locomotion facts; crouching selects collider and can coexist with state. No mutually exclusive whole-state sum type established; shape variants are Avian native enum.
lens_notes.aggregate_states: Standing/crouching/hand colliders derive from controller plus one collider; supported dimensions and readiness across failed setup need an explicit coherent state policy. setup early-return is a conditional per-population failure, not demonstrated ordinary reachability.
lens_notes.magic_numbers: Controller defaults carry distinct physical values and durations; Fabelgeist tactical factory overrides several including motor ownership. Zero acceleration and friction are intentional handoff to tactical motor, not automatic missing behavior. Range/invariant admission at all factories remains pending.
lens_notes.magic_strings: Feature flags, include documentation, doc aliases and tracing diagnostics are native configuration or display leaves; the assigned body has no business string API. Do not infer string-lens closure elsewhere.
lens_notes.existing_type_owners: Reuse Radians upstream of native CharacterLook, preserve native boundary conversion and distinct frame/shape semantics. Existing speed and duration types should be traced at actual producer and recipient before proposing broader propagation.
lens_notes.redundant_authority: CharacterLook is current input while CharacterControllerState.orientation is movement state updated from look or transform, not proven independently competing same fact. Tactical motor and Ahoy acceleration roles are explicitly coordinated in factory; other schedules remain pending.
lens_notes.behavior_preservation: Preserve typed valid yaw/pitch projection, roll-preserving camera apply versus zero-roll to_quat, optional look fallback, exact native shape meanings, sentinel timers and transient tactical authority. Repair guidance must preserve valid per-actor setup and retry semantics.
lens_notes.derivability: Derives on components and optional serialize are feature-gated, native framework adapters; actual trait contracts and feature unification were not independently resolved, so no boilerplate rewrite is claimed.
